nodes.description: owner: address state variable of Ownable contract storing the privileged account.
totalSupply: total token supply minted at construction and reduced by burn().
balances: mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances, updated by transfer/transferFrom/burn/constructor.
allowed: nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) holding ERC20 allowances.
name: constant token name 'SAAT'.
symbol: constant token symbol 'SAAT'.
decimals: constant 8 decimals.
initialSupply: constant 75000000 * 10**8 pre-minted supply.
Ownable() constructor: assigns ownership to msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier: requires msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded function.
transferOwnership(address newOwner): owner-only function that rewrites the owner state variable.
transfer(address _to, uint256 _value): moves tokens from msg.sender to _to using SafeMath.
balanceOf(address _owner): constant getter for balances[_owner].
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value): spends allowance and moves tokens.
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): overwrites the allowance of _spender without checking the previous value or return value.
allowance(address _owner, address _spender): constant getter for allowed[_owner][_spender].
increaseApproval(address _spender, uint _addedValue): adds to the current allowance.
decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint _subtractedValue): subtracts from the current allowance, clamping at zero.
burn(uint256 _value): destroys tokens from the caller balance and decrements totalSupply.
SAATCoin() constructor: sets totalSupply and grants the entire initial supply to msg.sender.
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b): checked multiplication with assert.
SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b): division relying on automatic throw on divide-by-zero.
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b): checked subtraction, asserts b <= a.
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b): checked addition, asserts c >= a.
msg.sender used as the initial owner in the Ownable constructor.
msg.sender compared against owner inside the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender is the debited account in transfer().
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom().
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve().
msg.sender is the allowance owner in increaseApproval().
msg.sender is the allowance owner in decreaseApproval().
msg.sender is the burner whose balance and allowance to burn is checked in burn().
msg.sender receives the whole initial supply in the SAATCoin constructor.
Unchecked-style balance arithmetic balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) in transfer() (SafeMath check present, but the debit/credit pair is state-mutating).
Balance credit balances[_to].add(_value) in transfer().
Debit balances[_from].sub(_value) in transferFrom() driven by user-supplied _from/_value.
Credit balances[_to].add(_value) in transferFrom().
Allowance decrement allowed[_from][msg.sender] = _allowance.sub(_value) in transferFrom().
approve() blindly overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender] with _value and returns true unconditionally, enabling the classic allowance race (no zero-first check).
Allowance increment allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue) in increaseApproval().
Branching allowance decrement oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue) with zero-clamping in decreaseApproval().
Burner balance decrement balances[burner].sub(_value) in burn().
Supply decrement totalSupply = totalSupply.sub(_value) in burn().

Parameter _to of transfer().
Parameter _value of transfer().

Parameter _to of transferFrom().
Parameter _value of transferFrom().

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable by the Ownable constructor.
The Ownable constructor performs the initial owner assignment.
onlyOwner compares untrusted msg.sender against the stored owner to authorize calls.
The onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferOwnership.
newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership logic.
Caller-supplied newOwner overwrites the privileged owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable.
msg.sender indexes balances as the debited account in transfer().
Destination address _to indexes balances in transfer().
User-supplied _value is subtracted from the sender balance.
msg.sender selects the balance entry subject to the checked subtraction.
Result of balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) is stored back into the balances mapping.
User-supplied _value is added to the destination balance.
Destination address _to selects the credited balance entry.
Result of balances[_to].add(_value) is stored back into the balances mapping.
transfer() executes the sender balance subtraction.
transfer() executes the destination balance addition.
_from selects the debited balance entry in transferFrom().
_value determines the amount debited from _from.
Result of balances[_from].sub(_value) is written back to balances.
_to selects the credited balance entry in transferFrom().
_value determines the amount credited to _to.
Result of balances[_to].add(_value) is written back to balances.
Cached _allowance is reduced by the transferred value.
_value is subtracted from the allowance.
The reduced allowance is stored back into allowed[_from][msg.sender].
The allowance mapping is read into the _allowance local variable.
msg.sender selects the spender entry of the allowance mapping in transferFrom().
transferFrom() executes the sender-side balance subtraction.
transferFrom() executes the receiver-side balance addition.
transferFrom() executes the allowance decrement.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping owner slot in approve().
_spender indexes the allowance mapping spender slot in approve().
_value is written directly into the allowance slot without any previous-value check.
approve() unconditionally overwrites the allowance storage slot.
approve() performs the unguarded allowance overwrite that enables the allowance race condition.
The unguarded approval write mutates allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
allowance() reads the allowed mapping.
_owner selects the allowance mapping owner slot in allowance().
_spender selects the allowance mapping spender slot in allowance().
_spender selects the allowance slot being increased.
_addedValue is added to the current allowance.
Result of the allowance addition is stored back into allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
increaseApproval() executes the allowance addition.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping in increaseApproval().
Cached oldValue is the base of the allowance subtraction.
_subtractedValue drives the allowance decrement branch.
The decremented (or zeroed) allowance is stored back into allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
decreaseApproval() executes the branching allowance subtraction.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender] is read into the oldValue local variable.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping in decreaseApproval().
_value is subtracted from the burner balance.
Result of balances[burner].sub(_value) is written back to the balances mapping.
_value is subtracted from totalSupply.
Result of totalSupply.sub(_value) is written back to totalSupply.
burn() executes the burner balance decrement.
burn() executes the total supply decrement.
msg.sender is copied into the burner local variable.
burner selects the balance entry that is reduced.
msg.sender indexes balances for the pre-burn balance check.
msg.sender receives the entire initial supply in the SAATCoin constructor.
initialSupply constant initializes totalSupply.
initialSupply constant initializes the deployer balance.
SAATCoin constructor assigns totalSupply.
SAATCoin constructor mints the whole supply to the deployer.
Operand a participates in the multiplication c = a * b.
Operand b participates in the multiplication c = a * b.
SafeMath.mul() computes and asserts on c.
Operand a participates in the division c = a / b.
Operand b is the divisor in c = a / b.
SafeMath.div() computes c and relies on automatic throw on division by zero.
Minuend a feeds the checked subtraction a - b.
Subtrahend b feeds the checked subtraction a - b.
Addend a feeds the checked addition a + b.
Addend b feeds the checked addition a + b.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor/parameter node is only meaningful as the argument of transferOwnership and should be folded into it.
_to is only used inside transfer() to select the credited balance entry.
_value is the operand of the SafeMath subtraction on the sender balance in transfer().
_owner is only used as the lookup key inside balanceOf().
_from selects the debited balance entry of the subtraction in transferFrom().
_to selects the credited balance entry of the addition in transferFrom().
_value is the amount subtracted from the allowance and from the source balance in transferFrom().
_spender is only used to select the allowance slot written by approve().
_value is written directly into the allowance slot by approve().
_owner is only used as the lookup key inside allowance().
_spender is only used as the lookup key inside allowance().
_spender only selects the allowance slot modified by increaseApproval().
_addedValue is the operand of the allowance addition in increaseApproval().
_spender only selects the allowance slot modified by decreaseApproval().
_subtractedValue drives the allowance decrement branch in decreaseApproval().
_value is the amount subtracted from both the burner balance and totalSupply in burn().
Operand a only exists as input to the checked multiplication.
Operand b only exists as input to the checked multiplication.
Operand a only exists as input to the division helper.
Divisor b only exists as input to the division helper.
Minuend a only exists as input to the checked subtraction.
Subtrahend b only exists as input to the checked subtraction.
Addend a only exists as input to the checked addition.
Addend b only exists as input to the checked addition.
Temporary c is created, asserted on and returned solely inside SafeMath.mul().
Temporary c is created and returned solely inside SafeMath.div().
The cached allowance only exists within transferFrom() to avoid a second storage read.
burner is just an alias of msg.sender used inside burn().
oldValue is a transient copy of the allowance used for the clamping comparison in decreaseApproval().
